newsitem.title: UK: M.A.I.D signs database deal with Fujitsu.
newsitem.headline: M.A.I.D signs database deal with Fujitsu.

text.p: British business services group M.A.I.D Plc said on Monday it had signed a agreement with Japanese computer company Fujitsu Ltd to provide database services.
The deal means Fujitsu will sell and support M.A.I.D's databases in Japan.
Fujitsu would take over representation of the Profound corporate intelligence solutions in Japan through its G-Search subsidiary, Japan's biggest database distributor.
M.A.I.D, Fujitsu and G-Search will also cooperate on future research and development of services for consumer markets.
M.A.I.D said the new product is likely to be a local language service and would provide customers with company information, industry news and research from Japan and around the world.
